notes.title: The Calyx Demo Update Playtest Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings Calyx players![/h2]

Our playtest for version 2 of the Calyx Demo is now open.

If you already requested access, you should now have the "Calyx Playtest" product in your Steam Library.

To request access now, visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211850/Calyx/]main Calyx Steam page[/url] and hit the button under “Join the Calyx playtest”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/b5a0c14233d2f341150671784b28e290e05eee91.gif[/img]

[h3]There are lots of new things to try out, including:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Challenge Mode with 5 new maps.
[*] New Calyx plants with new mechanics - watch out for the crawlers!
[*] Existing Calyx species have been upgraded.
[*] Calyx now level up - they get stronger the longer they're alive.
[*] New player units.
[*] Harvester based mining system.
[*] New resource - Isotopes!
[*] Boost Modules in the world - connect these to power for a bonus.
[*] "Drawable" walls and pylons.
[*] Re-bindable keys, adjustable UI scaling, and lots more QOL features.
[*] Original music from our long time collaborator Gavin Harrison.
[/list]
The tutorial has been updated with the major new systems, so that's a good place to start if you're new to Calyx or a seasoned pro.

We’re excited to hear what you think, and it would be super helpful if (once you’ve played) you could [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf3zWAm3X9Ygr2ljFwpJE8vMIh7h4lZwbbOFbL2bJY1n0qnLg/viewform?usp=header]fill out our playtest questionnaire[/url].

We hope you enjoy it.

Thanks!

John, Mark & Phil ːsteamhappyː
Studio 568

notes.title: Sign up for the Calyx Demo Update playtest
notes.notes:
[h2]Sign up in advance[/h2]
Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211850/Calyx/]Calyx Steam Page[/url], scroll down and hit the “Request Access” button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/94ecf7026dcc217202375b7a7f301853396bf365.png[/img]

[h2]“When can I play?”[/h2]
When the playtest is available we’ll publish another news post to let everyone know.

[h2]The playtest includes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenge Mode with 5 new maps.
[*] New types of Calyx.
[*] Existing Calyx are more sophisticated.
[*] Targeting system revised.
[*] New player unit types.
[*] Harvester based mining.
[*] Draw walls and pylons.
[*] New resource - Isotopes.
[*] Harvest, Healing & Power Boost Modules.
[*] Lots of new QOL features including re-bindable keys.
[/list]

[h2]New features – sneak preview[/h2]

[h3]Bastion[/h3]
[h3][i]Calyxa Castellum[/i][/h3]
This tough new Calyx rains down fire on any unit that strays into range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/c9282f453c9936136bb778eee30ee09d3cba8494.gif[/img]

[h3]Militia[/h3]
[h3][i]Calyxa Militum[/i][/h3]
This new species spawns creatures which attack your units and base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/6484345aecf6603249b447783cac387916b10a58.gif[/img]

[h3]Tormentor[/h3]
[h3][i]Calyxa Tormenta[/i][/h3]
The pink Calyx now has a proper name and more sophisticated behaviour. You can also see the new Orbital Laser weapon being used to take out a trunk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/3fd15fa53896a59e31b684314fa4acfc4ab9bf55.gif[/img]

[h2]Razorleaf[/h2]
[h3][i]Calyxa Propagare[/i][/h3]
Our old friend the green Calyx is also more advanced, growing additional nodules and levelling up in strength over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/c4447dbef4137ba157c7b9ffe8827df8973381cc.gif[/img]

[h3]Harvesters[/h3]
We’ve added a Harvester based mining system with a new Refinery building to collect that sweet Ore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/6854c7af877a6ab3ad28ebc7e7f1f1592129ad6f.gif[/img]

[h2]Player survey[/h2]
We’ll be creating a short survey so you can give feedback on the new features. There will be a link to the survey from within the playtest build.

[h2]Thanks for your support![/h2]
More than 50,000 players have now installed the Calyx Demo, which frankly blows our minds. We can’t wait to hear what you think of the new additions.

Thanks!

John, Mark & Phil ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Calyx Development Update – March 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Calyx players![/h1]

We’re delighted to say that more than 35,000 of you have now added the Calyx Demo to your library, since we first launched it for Steam’s RTS Fest on January 20th.

Thanks for all your detailed suggestions and feedback. We spent time reading and digesting your contributions, and combining them with our own.

It’s now time to give you a quick update on what we’re planning next.

It’s our intention to share a bigger slice of the game with you, and we’re aiming for around the middle of 2025 for the demo update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409241/672d768c986ffc7bc359fe958b13a742c4570f42.png[/img]

[h2]Here’s some of the stuff we’re working on…[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated targeting system for player units
[*] New types of Calyx plant
[*] New units (including plant units that make defenses far more important)
[*] A new resource
[*] A new mining system based on harvesters (no more trying to place mines to clear up every last scrap of ore)
[*] Existing modules and buildings in the world - connect to these for boosts
[*] More maps
[*] Lots of QOL features including more options and keyboard shortcuts
[*] Many smaller improvements
[/list]

We hope that gives you a good idea of where Calyx is going next.

We’d like to say a huge thanks to everyone who’s played, reviewed and wishlisted so far. We’re stoked so many of you see potential in the project!

Stay tuned for another update soon.

Cheers!

John, Mark and Phil ːsteamhappyː
